name: Sam
label: Committed Premium subscriber, ad-averse
who: I have paid for Spotify Premium for years, and I value ad-free listening, skipping freely and offline downloads. I use it on multiple devices and treat it as my main listening platform.
value_for_money: They see Premium as strong value. One says they get more value from it than from all their other streaming subscriptions combined, and others say the free tier is too restricted to be useful. Some would keep Premium even while cutting other services.
loyalty: Ad-free listening, downloads and playlist control keep them subscribed, and they say they would never go back to the free tier. Complaints about pop-up suggestions, UI changes and less playlist control are the reasons they give for growing frustrated.
pain_points: Pop-up suggestions and promoted content even for Premium
Less control over playlists and recommendations
reasons_to_stay: They say Premium gives them the most value for their listening through ad-free music, downloads, casting and skips. They keep it even while complaining about recommendations and UI changes, and one says Premium would be the last subscription they cancel.
tone: Emphatic and conversational, using sarcasm and caps when criticizing Spotify but defending Premium strongly.
